label: Diagram D1
caption: Diagram D1 Side hung window illustration with table references
description:
This is a single diagram, an elevation view of a window. A grey rectangular frame encloses a solid green quadrilateral that represents the sash; the left edge of the green shape is vertical and coincides with the left side of the frame, while the right edge is set inward, so the shape appears tilted, as if hinged on the left and partly opened.

Two dimensions and an angle are marked in green. The label "w" sits above a horizontal double-headed arrow that runs across the full width of the frame, from its left edge to its right edge. The label "h" sits beside a vertical double-headed arrow that spans the full height of the frame on the right-hand side. The Greek letter "α" is placed at the bottom, next to a short line, marking the angle between the slanted lower edge of the green shape and the horizontal bottom of the frame.

A green horizontal banner runs along the bottom of the image containing the white text "Diagram D1  Side hung window illustration with table references". No other symbols, parts or text are visible.
